messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — renewal for Acme Corp (POC-452) is coming due next month. They want to move from a 6mo trial to a 12‑month commit, +2x seats, and have asked for a 20% off list. Usage trended ~60% of forecast. POC extended for private deploy; security questionnaire still open. Can we do a one-time credit + special terms to close?

ashley_revops: Thanks — need a short commercial summary. Current committed ARR? Current effective discount? Any legal/SOW needs? Also attach the customer's rate card request if available.

maria_sales: Current committed ARR = $220k annualized (monthly billing today). They propose $400k ARR with the uplift. Effective discount today ~12%. Customer asks for 20% off because of the POC extension and slow ramp. I'll attach the email thread and a spreadsheet (will DM).

priya_se: From POC side: feature coverage looks good. But security is asking about KMS/HSM options + data residency for EU region. Private deploy will need a small infra uplift and a one-time setup SOW. That SOW isn't in the standard rate card.

tom_csm: CS note — customer health is good but ramp slower than expected. They're asking for commercial runway to hit their forecast. Timeline: sign by 2026-05-10 to hit Q2 targets.

dan_dealdesk: High level: we can consider a one-time onboarding credit and a discounted rate, but cap is 15% without exec sign-off. Options: 1) 12‑month with 15% off + $25k onboarding credit + commit floor of $350k ARR, 2) 6‑month bridge at 10% off then convert to 12mo at 12% off. Exclusions: on-prem/private deploy SOW and professional services not discounted. Need legal to review auto-renew and termination language.

maria_sales: If we push option 1 (15% + $25k credit + $350k floor) can we get quick approval? I can move to get exec review but would prefer deal desk pre-approval to avoid back-and-forth with customer.

ashley_revops: I can pre-approve up to 15% and $25k credit if we require a commit floor and include an overage kicker (usage tier >120% billed additional month). Also require that the private deploy SOW be delivered as a separate line item not eligible for discount. I'll log this as conditional approval.

sec-bot: Security ticket created: SEC-1234. Priority: high. Required: answers to KMS/HSM, data-at-rest encryption, key rotation policy, and SOC2 attestation. SLA: security review within 3 business days after responses posted.

priya_se: I'll populate a short answers doc for the security questions today. Quick notes: we support KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault), HSM via customer-managed HSM for private deploys, and we can add EU data residency to the private deployment. Will note extra infra cost ~ $18k one-time.

dan_dealdesk: Sounds workable. Formal decision: approve 15% max discount + $25k credit contingent on security ticket closure and SOW signed. Require commit floor at $350k ARR and clause: discounts don't apply to SOW/PS/third-party infra. Billing to issue prorated invoices on signature. Legal to review auto-renew and early-termination fees.

ashley_revops: I'll prepare the commercial memo and PO template and flag to billing. Please confirm final list of excluded SKUs.

maria_sales: Confirmed excluded SKUs: private_deploy_sow, infra_one_time (name: PD-INFRA-ONETIME), professional_services. I'll send the customer's updated order form once I get verbal ok.

tom_csm: I'll prep an internal customer slide to sync expectations and timeline for security closure. Will coordinate go/no-go on deploy after SEC-1234 is closed.

priya_se: Uploaded short answers doc to the ticket and added config notes + estimate. Ping me if security asks for a deeper walkthrough.

dan_dealdesk: Good. Once security marks SEC-1234 closed and SOW uploaded, deal desk will issue the final conditional approval memo. Exec escalation required only if customer insists >15% or additional credits.

maria_sales: Thanks all — I'll update the customer with option 1 and the conditional terms. Will post the signed order form here when I have it. :thumbsup:

ashley_revops: One more: log this as a retention uplift — track in the renewals tracker and set reminder 30 days after sign to audit usage and overage tiers.

maria_sales: Will do. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

sec-bot: SEC-1234 status: awaiting triage — security team assigned: priya_se, reviewer: santiago_sec.

maria_sales: Follow-up — customer verbally accepted conditional terms, asking for final order form. Moving to get signatures today. I'll attach final OF when signed.

dan_dealdesk: Noted. Please route the signed OF to dealdesk@redwood for records.

maria_sales: Sent to dealdesk@redwood and billing. Closing thread once OF processed.

tom_csm: :party-parrot: congrats team, nice save on retention.
